definitions.meaning: hóa đơn, biên lai mua hàng

examples: Could I have a receipt, please?
Keep your receipt in case you want to return the item.

definitions.meaning: chiết khấu, giảm giá
giảm giá

examples: They're offering a 20% discount on all shoes this weekend.
Do you give a discount for students?

definitions.meaning: món hời, hàng giá rẻ
mặc cả, thương lượng giá

examples: I found a real bargain at the market — a leather bag for only five dollars.
You can bargain with the sellers at the night market.

definitions.meaning: tiền hoàn lại, tiền hoàn trả
hoàn tiền lại

examples: The store gave me a full refund because the jacket was damaged.
They refused to refund my money without a receipt.

definitions.meaning: quầy tính tiền, khu vực thanh toán

examples: There was a long queue at the checkout.
Please go to checkout 3 — it's the shortest line.

definitions.meaning: thu ngân, người tính tiền

examples: The cashier scanned all my items very quickly.
Ask the cashier if they accept credit cards.

definitions.meaning: đủ tiền để mua, có khả năng chi trả

examples: I like that coat, but I can't afford it right now.
We finally saved enough money to afford a new car.

definitions.meaning: tiền tệ, đơn vị tiền tệ

examples: You should exchange your currency at the airport or a bank.
The local currency is the Vietnamese dong.

definitions.meaning: tỷ giá hối đoái

examples: Check the exchange rate before converting your money.
The exchange rate today is 25,000 dong per dollar.

definitions.meaning: ngân sách, số tiền dự định chi tiêu
lập kế hoạch chi tiêu

examples: We set a strict budget for the trip to avoid overspending.
Try to budget your money carefully each month.

definitions.meaning: nhãn giá, thẻ ghi giá sản phẩm

examples: Always check the price tag before putting something in your basket.
The price tag had fallen off, so the cashier had to look it up.

definitions.meaning: giao dịch mua hàng, vật mua được
mua, mua sắm

examples: You can return any purchase within 30 days.
She purchased a new phone online last night.

definitions.meaning: kỳ trả góp, thanh toán theo đợt

examples: I'm paying for my laptop in monthly installments.
You can buy the fridge in 12 installments with zero interest.

definitions.meaning: đợt giảm giá; việc bán hàng

examples: The department store is having a big sale this weekend.
I got these jeans on sale for half the original price.

definitions.meaning: ví (đựng tiền, thẻ)

examples: I left my wallet at home and couldn't pay for my lunch.
He keeps all his cards in a slim leather wallet.

definitions.meaning: rút tiền (từ tài khoản ngân hàng)

examples: I need to withdraw some cash before going to the market.
You can withdraw up to 5 million dong per day from this ATM.

definitions.meaning: tiền đặt cọc; tiền gửi vào tài khoản
gửi tiền vào ngân hàng; đặt cọc

examples: You need to pay a deposit of 10% when you order.
I deposited my salary into my savings account this morning.

definitions.meaning: hóa đơn (thương mại), phiếu yêu cầu thanh toán

examples: The supplier sent us an invoice for the goods we ordered.
Please pay the invoice within 14 days of receiving it.

definitions.meaning: thẻ tín dụng

examples: Do you accept credit cards, or is it cash only?
She paid for the flight with her credit card to earn reward points.

definitions.meaning: máy rút tiền tự động (Automated Teller Machine)

examples: Is there an ATM near here? I need to get some cash.
The ATM was out of order, so I had to go into the bank.

definitions.meaning: lối đi giữa các kệ hàng trong siêu thị

examples: The cereal is in aisle 4, next to the bread.
She walked up and down every aisle looking for the right sauce.

definitions.meaning: chủ cửa hàng, người bán hàng

examples: The shopkeeper offered us a free sample of the cheese.
I asked the shopkeeper to hold the item for me until tomorrow.

definitions.meaning: tính tiền quá nhiều, bắt chẹt giá

examples: I think the restaurant overcharged us — the bill doesn't look right.
Always count your change to make sure you haven't been overcharged.

definitions.meaning: xe đẩy hàng (trong siêu thị)

examples: Grab a shopping cart — we have a lot of things to buy today.
She filled the shopping cart with groceries for the whole week.

definitions.meaning: tiền thối lại, tiền lẻ
thối tiền; đổi tiền

examples: I paid with a 100,000 dong note and got 20,000 in change.
Can you change a 500,000 dong bill? I need smaller notes.
